people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: She said to her mistress, “I wish that my lord were with the prophet who is in Samaria! Then he would heal him of his leprosy.”
translations.bsb: She said to her mistress, “If only my master would go to the prophet who is in Samaria, he would cure him of his leprosy.”
translations.kjv: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.
translations.asv: And she said unto her mistress, Would that my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! then would he recover him of his leprosy.
